# awfind

> A portable search client — query, results, ranking.

An agent with no search guesses from training data; an agent handed a raw web API gets ten blue links and burns its context reading them.

## Install

```
pip install awfind
```

## In Claude Code

- mcp: `awfind mcp`

## Use it in 30 seconds

Ask one question and get ranked answers back instead of a page of results.

## Composes with

- [awdk](https://aitherium.github.io/awdk/) — Build AI agent fleets — 3 lines, any backend, local or cloud.
- [awbrowse](https://aitherium.github.io/awbrowse/) — A portable browser client — navigate, console, network, DOM, screenshot.
- [awsh](https://aitherium.github.io/awsh/) — Your terminal answers you -- type a question where a command would go.
- [awembed](https://aitherium.github.io/awembed/) — Train an embedding model that knows your corpus, and prove it beats the big one.
